gameDescriptionHtml:
Lone Soul is a hack-and-slash roguelite combining fluid, combo-driven combat with strategic build customization. As Varus, a powerful and flamboyant conqueror, your mission takes you deep into the core of the mythical chaos tower.

Your efforts will determine whether you ignite a spark of hope for Revelia, a lone soul descending into darkness. With precise strikes, rune-based upgrades, and ever-changing challenges, each rescue attempt offers fresh opportunities and dangers.

Game Features

  • Express Yourself in Combat – Combat rewards style and precision, allowing you to unleash devastating combos. Forge bonds with mighty Keepers of Order to reshape your skills and increase your gear rarity. Prophecies grant you powerful bonuses, but only if you’re daring enough to face riskier challenges.
  • First Victory Is Just the Beginning – Reaching the tower’s core is only the start. Step through the Gate of Challenges to confront empowered forces and unveil the true ending. Each return presents fresh threats, evolving tactics, and a chance to surpass everything you thought was your limit.
  • Loot Enemies to Shape Your Builds – Defeated foes drop mystical runes that you slot into expansive skill trees, leveling up gear and unlocking powerful abilities. Manage your resources strategically and shape builds ranging from glass cannon to extremely tanky.
  • From Keeper to Conqueror – As Varus, formerly a patron of shadow, you undertake a risky quest to rescue Revelia, a previous conqueror imprisoned deep within the tower. Traverse three floors and become the last hope for her trapped soul slipping towards eternal darkness.
  • Floor Guardians Don’t Play Fair – Each floor culminates in an intense boss battle against foes equipped with unique traits, demanding fresh tactics and adaptability. Beware, on the brink of defeat, Guardians summon deadly projections, further escalating stakes and your combat intensity.
